text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—Honk hooooonk!
—Honk hooooonk!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Nice! Make it feel more like a real battlefield!
Give me a warrior's face!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! Wait, ah...!
Kiseki's Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I haven't updated my social media in a while, so my fans started worrying...
But I didn't really have anything specific to write about...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The plan is to show off a lively Still-chan
with a hilarious short video directed by Kiseki!
That's how we'll do it!
choice_data_list: I see, so that's what's going on!
I see, so that's how it is!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After hearing the situation, I felt like supporting them.
Is there anything I can do to help?
When I offered...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure!?
Then please handle the camera!
I've already finished the storyboard...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A "storyboard" is a blueprint with the image of
each shot and lines written down.
Kiseki had apparently drawn quite a few of them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And the photoshoot began!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Cut!
Deliver that line more casually!
Keep the comedic timing of the running gag in mind!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, I love it! It's even better than I pictured!
Ooh~~! I sense a masterpiece in the making!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm sure we'll make something really interesting!
Yeah, I'm sure we can make something really interesting!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The shoot went smoothly, and we took a break!
Feeling a bit tired, I went to buy some sweets,
and when I came back to my seat...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, camera test...!
No filter needed, right?
Hehe, Still-chan's cake looks delicious♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san ordered
a parfait, so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Just then!
My hand slipped, and the parfait tilted.
However...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Like I'd let youuuu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SMACK! PLOOOOP!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki instinctively grabbed the parfait glass,
sending the top strawberry flying with such momentum
that it landed right on Still in Love's plate...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Huh... What...?
How could this be...
choice_data_list: S-Sorry! Here, you can have it...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Heh...! Hehehe...!
Are you sure about this...?
Ah, the strawberries... they've multiplied...♡

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Pfft...! This is...!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha!
Eeeek! Amazing! What was that just now!?
Ahaha...! My stomach hurts...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't stop laughing for quite a while.
That unintentionally captured, manga-like moment
was hilarious no matter how many times I looked at it...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
――Now then, moving right along.
Let's upload that video Kiseki made for us right away...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
…………
No, wait...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: More importantly, the one before was way funnier!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Kiseki showed was a scene from earlier
that happened to be caught on camera.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It stings to admit it, but this one will definitely be more popular.
Still-chan's fans will be thrilled too, I'm sure..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: B-But... you worked so hard to make it for me.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the process doesn't matter.
What's interesting is interesting...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I give up.
After wracking my brain so much,
to think a sheer coincidence could produce such a masterpiece...!
choice_data_list: Um, what if you upload both...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ha! That's it!
That sounds great!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Look at me, jumping to conclusions...!
Acting like I've already lost for no reason...!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: That just shows how seriously you take it... creating something "fun"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki had a complicated look on her face.
Her obsession with entertainment versus her own creative vision...
She must be torn between the two.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What if... mine is the only one
that people call "boring"...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Inhaaaale, exhaaaale...
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you don't publish it, nothing begins!
That's what creating is all about!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki uploaded two videos along with unique comments.
After waiting restlessly for the reactions, a few days later...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yaaayyyy!
Both of them are total hits!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Kiseki-san looks so happy.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Though as expected, it's not quite going as viral
as the one we took by total accident.
choice_data_list: Kiseki's idea was a big hit too!
There's something amazing about fun you can't calculate, isn't there?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
There's even a comment saying,
'This is what I came here for!'

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about the number of Umalikes, right?
My work has resonated with someone out there.
I've truly moved their heart...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...! I'm so glad I warmed up!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I reallllly...! Just cannot win against
that kind of stuff!
Grrrr...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm gonna win! Someday!
I'll come up with something fun
that won't lose to that, too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it!
Kiseki's battle has only just begun—!
